generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch on GM Ultium: 85 kWh pack, DC up to 150 kW. From 2025 every trim uses the larger pack (the planned smaller-battery 1LT was never built). The 2027 change is the charge port only (NACS), so not split. Canada and US share the powertrain; Wikipedia gives only sales numbers for Canada. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Equinox_EV
